text:
Maya S.: Morning — quick handoff. Pushed model v1.2.3 to staging and ran the prompt_set_2026 evals. Seeing ~+4% regression on entity extraction for long_context cases. I opened PR #482 that changes prompt normalization + small tokenization tweak. Can someone glance?

Tomas R.: I'll take a look after lunch. Quick Q — is the failing subset the long_context bucket only? :eyes:

Priya K.: Yup, long_context only. Blocker: CI reproduces an OOM on quant test when seq_len > 2048. Repro: `./scripts/run_eval --model v1.2.3 --set long_context` — hangs around step 3.

Ryan L.: I can pair with you @Priya at 3pm PT to repro. Also flagged that the dedicated rollout didn't pin v1.2.2; opened ticket #873 so we don't accidentally promote.

Kai: Minor config idea — reduce kv cache prefetch to avoid peak mem. E.g.:
```
runtime.kv_prefetch: 0.8
```
Helped my local repro, might be a short-term mitigation while we debug tokenization.

eval-bot: EVAL BOT: Finished run for v1.2.3 on prompt_set_2026. Summary: overall F1 stable, long_context F1 dropped 0.842 -> 0.806. Full logs at https://ci.redwood.ai/evals/1832114321/results

Maya S.: Thanks — @Tomas please review PR #482 when you have a moment. @Priya let's pair at 3pm. I'll hold the canary rollout until we either patch or confirm safe fallback.

Tomas R.: On it — leaving comments on the PR now, mostly around prompt escaping edge-case.

Priya K.: pushed a tiny fix to normalization that avoids the extra token insertion, CI re-run started.

Ryan L.: LGTM on the quick fix :thumbsup:

Maya S.: Great. Canary paused; I'll update the rollout ticket when CI green and we merge. Thanks everyone!
